channel.title: Jay Respawns — Patch Notes (Official Sources Only)
channel.description: Official patch notes from developer and publisher sources. No press outlets. Updated daily.

item.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 10/6/2026
item.description:
TESTING:

Starting tomorrow, October 7th at approximately 10am PT, we will be conducting a matchmaking test by enabling cross-play as the default option for all players, on all platforms in the US-West servers. The intention of this test is to shorten queue times and tighten matchmaking skill bands. This test will run until the season ends on November 3rd. Console players can opt out of the test by turning off cross-play in your settings menu.

item.title: Galactic Network Maintenance
item.description:
Galactic Network Maintenance will occur on Tuesday, October 6th @ 8:00 UTC. Any Helldivers remaining in-atmosphere during the blackout may be lost along with any rewards.

Backend maintenance will last 2 hours. Follow Super Earth communication channels for updates.

item.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

  • Added sv_wallbug convar to allow previous movement behavior on community servers (related to the missed note at the bottom)
  • Fixed view jitter that occurs and persists when playing for extended periods of time
  • Fixed snd_mix_async from crashing the game
  • Fixed sv_parallel_sends

item.title: Phasmophobia v0.19.1.0 - Patch Notes
item.description:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have an update for you.

Today’s small update is in preparation for Crimson Eye, launching 8th October 2026, with the focus on getting the game ready for the start of the event. Our next major update, our move to Unity 6 is scheduled for November and will feature a host of bug fixes and improvements, all of which we’ll detail in an upcoming Development Preview.
